name: teamhood
label: Teamhood
description: Visual project management for boards, tasks, and timelogs in Teamhood.

baseUrl.label: API URL
baseUrl.description: Your tenant-specific Teamhood API URL (e.g. https://api-YOURTENANT.teamhood.com). The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Teamhood API key generated from Settings → Integrations → Teamhood API in Teamhood.

create_item.label: Create Item
create_item.description: Create a new item (task) in a Teamhood board.

boardId.label: Board
boardId.description: Select a board in the chosen workspace.

description.label: Description
description.description: Optional description for the item. Plain text or HTML.

rowId.label: Row
rowId.description: Select a swimlane row on the selected board. Rows group items horizontally on a Kanban board.

statusId.label: Status
statusId.description: The status column on the board (e.g. To Do, In Progress, Done).

assignedUserId.label: Assignee
assignedUserId.description: The user this item is assigned to.

ownerId.label: Owner
ownerId.description: The user who owns this item.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: When work on this item should start.

estimation.label: Estimation (hours)
estimation.description: Estimated effort to complete the item, in hours.

progress.label: Progress (%)
progress.description: Percentage of work completed, between 0 and 100. Leave empty to track progress automatically.

milestone.label: Is Milestone
milestone.description: Mark this item as a milestone.

completed.label: Mark as Completed
completed.description: Create the item as already completed.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: List of tag names to attach to the item.

update_item.label: Update Item
update_item.description: Update an existing Teamhood item. Only fields you fill in will be updated.

boardId.label: Board
boardId.description: Select a board in the chosen workspace.

itemId.label: Item
itemId.description: The Teamhood item (task) to operate on. Select a workspace to load items.

title.label: Title
title.description: New title for the item. Leave empty to keep current title.

description.label: Description
description.description: New description for the item. Leave empty to keep current description.

rowId.label: Row
rowId.description: Select a swimlane row on the selected board. Rows group items horizontally on a Kanban board.

statusId.label: Status
statusId.description: The status column on the board (e.g. To Do, In Progress, Done).

assignedUserId.label: Assignee
assignedUserId.description: New assignee for the item. Leave empty to keep current assignee.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: Mark the item as completed or not.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: List of tag names. This REPLACES the current tags on the item.

get_item.label: Get Item
get_item.description: Retrieve a single Teamhood item by ID.

boardId.label: Board
boardId.description: Select a board in the chosen workspace.

itemId.label: Item
itemId.description: The Teamhood item (task) to operate on. Select a workspace to load items.

find_items.label: Find Items
find_items.description: Search for Teamhood items using filters.

boardId.label: Board
boardId.description: Select a board in the chosen workspace.

rowId.label: Row
rowId.description: Select a swimlane row on the selected board. Rows group items horizontally on a Kanban board.

statusId.label: Status
statusId.description: The status column on the board (e.g. To Do, In Progress, Done).

assignedUserId.label: Assignee
assignedUserId.description: Only return items assigned to this user.

ownerId.label: Owner
ownerId.description: Only return items owned by this user.

completed.label: Completion Status
completed.description: Filter by completion. Leave empty to return both.

createdSince.label: Created Since
createdSince.description: Only return items created after this UTC date/time.

modifiedSince.label: Modified Since
modifiedSince.description: Only return items modified after this UTC date/time.

completedSince.label: Completed Since
completedSince.description: Only return items completed after this UTC date/time.

includeChildItems.label: Include Sub-items
includeChildItems.description: Include child items (sub-tasks) in the results.

take.label: Max Results
take.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.label: Skip
skip.description: Number of items to skip — useful for pagination.

create_row.label: Create Board Row
create_row.description: Create a new horizontal swimlane row on a Teamhood board.

boardId.label: Board
boardId.description: Select a board in the chosen workspace.

title.label: Row Title
title.description: The title for the new swimlane row.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: Optional start date for the row (timeline view).

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: Optional end date for the row (timeline view).
